text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Welcome, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: This is the Victory Club!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Children
text_block_list.text: Welcome!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the sun shines high above on this
tranquil day,
I find myself surrounded by
children.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, everyone! It's time to show
this Tracen
Academy trainer how hard
you work!
choice_data_list: お招き頂きありがとうございます！
choice_data_list_en: Thank you so much for inviting me!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Children
text_block_list.text: Yeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Victory Club is a famous group
dedicated to
training young
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It comprises a highly talented team and
boasts an
impressive track record,
having produced several
famous racers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To continue my development as a
trainer, I've
come here today to observe
the Victory Club in
action.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
We'll be training outside today, so be
careful you
don't hurt yourselves!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Children
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll be happy to answer any
questions you
have as class
representative—wait a moment, I
guess
I'm a club alum today!
choice_data_list: 2人はこのクラブのOGなんだよな
2人はこのクラブのOGなんだよね
choice_data_list_en: The two of them are alumnae of this club, right?
The two of them are alumnae of this club, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Many Umamusume who bear the Sakura
name
have joined this club—Sakura
Bakushin O and
Sakura Chiyono O
among them.
choice_data_list: 『サクラ』の子が多いって聞いたけど？
choice_data_list_en: I heard there are a lot of 'Sakura' girls, though?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Well, you see, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Those with "Sakura" in their name are
just
naturally drawn to the Victory Club!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's our destiny! All Sakuras are fated to
join us!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um, well... My mom was a member of
this club, so
that's how I got connected
to it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I think one reason there are so many
Sakuras here
is that our members value
those connections very
much.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, my mom's a Victory
Club
alum too! Ha-ha-ha-ha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next, I observe the youngsters as they
train. Their
regimen is just as grounded
in theory as I'd expect
from such a
famed club.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Right! And since the club members are
all young
children, we ensure that the
training sessions
don't become too much
of a physical burden.
choice_data_list: やっぱりレベルが高いな
やっぱりレベルが高いね
choice_data_list_en: The competition really is fierce, huh.
The competition really is fierce, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They incorporate games like dodgeball
into
training to break up the monotony. I
imagine the
children love the variety.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Children
text_block_list.text:
Ouch!
It hurts!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh no!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All of a sudden, one of the children is in
pain
after a big tumble!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Stop, Trainer! Don't help her up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The motto of the Victory Club is...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text:
Don't lose spirit! Stay positive and keep
going!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! Remember, you're a member of
this club
too! You're a strong kid who
can get back up on
your own!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Are you injured? Try moving your foot
around.
...Okay, it looks fine. Why don't
you see if you
can stand up?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text: R-right! I'll try!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Okay, get ready! All together now!
VICTORY!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O & the Child
text_block_list.text: VICTORY!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, the young girl puts all her
strength into
her legs, then proudly
stands up before dashing
off to rejoin
the other children.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer! What do you think of the
Victory
Club?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer! What do you think of the
Victory
Club?
choice_data_list: ここはとってもいいクラブだな！
ここはとってもいいクラブだね！
2人の強さの秘訣がわかったよ
choice_data_list_en: This is a really great club!
This is a really great club!
Now I understand the secret to their strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in this club believes in their
fellow
members. They work together to
overcome any
difficulty.
choice_data_list: ここはとってもいいクラブだな！
ここはとってもいいクラブだね！
2人の強さの秘訣がわかったよ
choice_data_list_en: This is a really great club!
This is a really great club!
Now I understand the secret to their strength.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Now you get it! I'm so proud to
have been a
member of this club!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
We're like two carrots that grew in the
same
patch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Victory Club is a passionate
organization
whose members form strong
bonds and support
each other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, I learned another way to show
someone
kindness besides just lending
them a helping
hand.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, children with the Sakura name are
tough,
aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You can expect great things from all the
young
members of the Victory Club!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With my enthusiasm for training
rekindled, I feel
like I can't afford to rest
on my laurels!
